text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“The day of my debut is finally here! I 
was really looking forward to it... 
but...”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The audience seems worried because of how 
young I am. They've even started 
questioning if you're taking proper care 
of me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I work super hard, do you think people 
will start recognizing you too, 
Trainer...?
